title: Learning to Infer: Statistical Inference through Meta Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study meta learning for statistical inference, in which neural networks learn inference rules from simulated tasks and apply them to new datasets without parameter updates, providing a form of in-context learning. We draw on statistical decision theory to design training objectives whose population minimizers are Bayes rules and exploit their connections to classical inference procedures to establish frequentist guarantees for the learned rules. The structure of classical inference procedures also motivates the design of our neural network architecture, called Residual Recurrent Deep Sets (RRDS), which repeatedly aggregates information across observations in a permutation-invariant manner and refines its internal state through residual updates. Under suitable regularity and training conditions, we establish asymptotic efficiency in parameter estimation, consistency in model selection, and variable selection guarantees in high-dimens

translated_title: 学会推断：通过元学习实现统计推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究用于统计推断的元学习，其中神经网络从模拟任务中学习推断规则，并将其应用于新数据集而无需参数更新，从而提供了一种形式的上下文学习。我们借鉴统计决策理论来设计训练目标，使其总体最小化器为贝叶斯规则，并利用其与经典推断程序之间的联系，为学习到的规则建立频率学派的统计保证。经典推断程序的结构也启发了我们神经网络架构的设计，该架构称为残差循环深度集合，它以置换不变的方式反复聚合观测之间的信息，并通过残差更新来精炼其内部状态。在适当的正则性和训练条件下，我们建立了参数估计的渐近有效性、模型选择的一致性，以及高维情形下的变量选择保证。
tldr: 该论文将统计决策理论与元学习相结合，提出残差循环深度集合网络架构，使神经网络能从模拟任务中学习推断规则并无需参数更新地应用于新数据，同时为学习到的规则建立了渐近有效性、模型选择一致性和高维变量选择等频率学派统计保证。
en_tdlr: This paper combines statistical decision theory with meta learning by proposing a Residual Recurrent Deep Sets architecture whose learned inference rules can be applied to new datasets without parameter updates, while achieving frequentist guarantees including asymptotic efficiency, model selection consistency, and high-dimensional variable selection.
